method: Manually identified original yellow double-up-arrow Holovator class map icons in two owner photos of overlapping areas. W06->W07 approximate translation estimated from three corresponding icons plus independent WZ3 crest landmark. Pre-existing 3-control affine source-JPG registrations are used only for exploratory native Atlas pixel estimates, not exact device points.

strong_interpretation: Three distinct yellow map symbols (including Rouge Plaza, Hibernal Avenue and Jaune Sector 4) are corroborated in two separately panned owner screenshots; alignment of the same symbols is strongly supported at the camera-photo level.

additional_single_photo_lead.overlap_warning: The icon lies near the left margin of W10 and its exact ground doorway and rooftop exit are unknown.

external_whole_city_reference.author_report: Original Chinese-language player guide states all climbable ladders and holographic elevator distribution; nine elevators initially broken and restored through side missions; previously examined/unusable Holovators appear gray on the player's in-game map after approach/interact.
external_whole_city_reference.role: Independent cross-check of icon-class/quest count and red-circled mission repair map; Chinese reference image NOT copied, redistributed or pixel-extracted into public repo
external_whole_city_reference.caution: Small rendered external image and no calibrated marker-category XY; cannot choose one of the owner's earlier mission #4 source-native coordinate alternatives solely by its annotation. Category count 23 is separately established by Shackmaps.

older_photo_ambiguity.status: independent_same_icon_between_W06_and_W07_but_exact_mission_device_unresolved; do not arbitrarily select old alternatives or publish as exact

critical_limits: Original screenshot photo coordinates are not game-world coordinates.

Fit on W06/W07 is a simple translation in camera photograph space. Low 2.1px agreement proves same yellow icons at corresponding positions; it does not validate their original Atlas image coordinates.

Original source-image affine maps for W06 and W07 used three controls; fitted zero training error is tautological and independent accuracy is not established. For Jaune Sector 4 they differ >45 pixels.
Quest location/pink star is not the same dataset as a specific already discovered Holovator chevron or physical facade.
Neither external category stable ID nor ground entrance/roof exit height measured.
Do not count any of these matches as additional distinct verified physical category devices until deduplicated with the reported 23.
